title: Lee Collins's style and Buddy Petit
summary: Collins played in the style of Buddy Petit, whom Stevenson praises as a fine second trumpet player.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: How did Lee play in those days? Oh, Lee was good.
I think, uh, Buddy Petit taught him from the way he used to play. He used to play on the style of Buddy Petit. That was a good trumpet player, Buddy.
Oh, you got to hear him a good deal too?
Yeah, Buddy was one of the best second trumpet players I think was around here. He could play plenty second. Yeah, he was good on that Buddy Petit.
